unit: | **Status** | **Proposed.** ⚑ **Corregido 2026-09-02: esto abría *"Nothing here is built"* mientras §5 enumeraba doce barras cubiertas** — la misma dirección de infra-declaración que la regla de autoría 7 dice que nadie persigue, y que §5 ya se había corregido a sí misma el 2026-08-31 sin que esta fila se enterara. Lo construido vive en `feat/delegated-signature`, fusionado en `integration/claimable-delegated` y **sin publicar**; §6 lo enumera. `Status` sigue `Proposed` por dos razones que no son falta de verde: §3.3 son preguntas legales que no se contestan en este repositorio, y la **barra 12 está incumplida y declarada** (ver §5 y [`BL-214`](../BACKLOG.md), donde consta que aterrizar con ella abierta se decidió a sabiendas). The `signsVia` declaration, the recorded-only executed member, the cross-slot invariant, the assertion record, the route and the entitlement are all targets, enumerated in §5 with the bars that would promote this to `Accepted`. One of those bars is not this repository's to turn green alone: the contractual half (§3.3) is legal work. A second precondition was **retracted on 2026-08-24** — §2.8 required a per-key entitlement until its premise was checked and found false, and now records why a gate scoped to this one route would be the appearance of a control ([`BL-184`](../BACKLOG.md)). |

What was built lives on `feat/delegated-signature`, merged into `integration/claimable-delegated` and **unpublished**; §6 lists it. `Status` stays `Proposed` for two reasons that are not a lack of green: §3.3 holds legal questions that are not answered in this repository, and **bar 12 is unmet and declared** (see §5 and [`BL-214`](../BACKLOG.md), which records that landing with it open was decided knowingly). The `signsVia` declaration, the recorded-only executed member, the cross-slot invariant, the assertion record, the route and the entitlement are all targets, enumerated in §5 with the bars that would promote this to `Accepted`. A second precondition was **retracted on 2026-08-24** — §2.8 required a per-key entitlement until its premise was checked and found false, and now records why a gate scoped to this one route would be the appearance of a control ([`BL-184`](../BACKLOG.md)). |
